prompts.name: 棘冠背兽
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent PNG sprite cutout for a Chinese hand-painted post-apocalyptic courtyard survival game. Design an entirely NEW BOSS ANIMAL named the Thorn-Crowned Bastion: a low enormous six-legged forest shield-beetle with an arched bark-and-bone carapace, a broad shovel-like brow shield, branching thorn crown, two tiny amber eyes underneath, massive gripping forelegs, green moss seams and an exposed ochre throat. NOT a humanoid, boar, ordinary turtle or existing monster. It charges gates using its crown; the vulnerable throat must be visibly identifiable. Single complete full body, 3/4 side view facing LEFT, camera slightly above at about 25 degrees, feet aligned to a ground plane, centered with 10% transparent margin. Painterly ink-and-gouache illustration, warm desaturated earth brown, ochre and moss, dark readable contour, carefully painted organic texture, visual clarity at 110 pixels tall, matching an illustrated survival board game. No ground patch, cast shadow, backdrop, text, labels, borders, UI, watermark, gore, glow fog or particles. True transparent alpha background. Only ONE animal.

prompts.name: 穴灯巢母
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent PNG creature sprite for the same warm ink-and-gouache Chinese post-apocalyptic courtyard survival game. Entirely NEW BOSS species, the Burrow Lantern Matriarch: a squat underground mantis-salamander with four curved spade foreclaws and two rear anchoring legs, a large drooping pear-shaped abdomen of translucent pale jade egg chambers, tiny cream egg shapes inside, a hooded eyeless wedge head carrying two small warm ivory feeler lanterns, ribbed clay-colored throat and earthy shell scales. Silhouette unlike any boar, humanoid, ordinary insect or frog. It makes underground brood nests; claws and brood abdomen are the main identifying shapes. One complete animal facing LEFT in 3/4 side view, slightly top-down 25 degrees, feet on a common ground plane, 10% clear transparent margin, centered. Hand-painted dark ink outline, desaturated jade, bone, umber, soft amber lanterns; organic dry-brush textures; readable at 115px tall, no photoreal or 3D render. No environment, floor patch, shadow, text, labels, UI, borders, watermark, blood or dismemberment. True transparent alpha background.

prompts.name: 吞烬囊鲸
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent PNG boss sprite, ink-and-gouache post-apocalyptic courtyard survival game. Invent an entirely NEW animal, the Ember-Swallowing Cistern Whale: an amphibious low-hovering kettle-shaped whale-moth with a huge pale ochre pleated belly, four small splayed fin-legs touching the ground, copper gill vents, a long downward-curving siphon trunk, a ring of swept-back teal ear fins, a dark charcoal dorsal ridge and a translucent amber furnace sac visible in its chest. Its head is at the left; the siphon draws warmth from campfires, then the sac bursts into a cooling molt. Clearly an original animal, not dragon, mammal, humanoid, ordinary whale or existing slime-spitter. One full body in 3/4 LEFT-facing side view, 25-degree elevated camera, grounded, centered with 10% transparent margin. Distinct broad round silhouette, expressive small turquoise eyes, warm muted ochre/teal/charcoal palette, hand-painted paper illustration texture and dark ink contours. Readable at 115 pixels tall. Transparent background, no fire outside the body, no smoke, no glow halo, no scenery, no ground patch or shadow, no text, watermark or UI.

prompts.name: 并生双脉
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT HORIZONTAL SPRITE ATLAS containing THREE equal-width cells in ONE ROW for a newly invented final boss animal and its split forms. All three cells have invisible backgrounds, generous empty gutters, absolutely no panels, borders, text or labels. Cell1 LEFT: complete final boss "Concord Twinvein", a single low quadrupedal root-and-membrane animal whose back rises into TWO distinct leaf-shaped fan hoods, one muted violet, one pale jade, sharing an ivory glowing chest heart and braided dark woody legs. Two small triangular heads project forward LEFT under the fans, with thin pale living tendrils connecting their necks. NOT a deer, dragon, humanoid, flower pot or existing game monster. Cell2 MIDDLE: a separate smaller LEFT-HALF OFFSPRING, one violet fan hood, one triangular head, three root feet, pale heart filament trailing right. Cell3 RIGHT: separate smaller RIGHT-HALF OFFSPRING, jade fan hood, one head, three root feet, heart filament trailing left. Show each complete animal as a clean isolated cutout, facing LEFT at consistent slightly top-down 25-degree 3/4 angle, feet baseline at 85% of each cell. All subjects fit wholly WITHIN THEIR OWN THIRD; no overlapping neighboring cells; 10% margin inside each cell. The mother is larger, offspring 75% of mother height. Warm desaturated ink and gouache, painterly organic bark/leaf texture, elegant dark outline, cream heart accents, survival boardgame aesthetic, readable at 110px tall. True transparent alpha, no scenery or ground patch, no cast shadows, no text, labels, watermarks, UI, blood or gore.
